title: Wear OS Watch Faces: Navigating Community, Customization, and Creator Trust
excerpt: The Wear OS watch face community is a vibrant hub of creativity, but it also demands vigilance. We discuss the importance of trust in choosing watch faces and the rising demand for deep customization.

title: New Wear OS Upgrades focus on Battery & Design customization
excerpt: Google just announced major refinements to the Watch Face Format, offering designers and users much better battery life and richer complication options.
